answer: Attest the model fingerprint, not the account name. A panel of three must show three distinct fingerprints, or the attestation is void. Quorum must span unrelated subnetworks so one provider cannot supply the whole jury. Budget per identity: one fingerprint, one bond, one vault entry. The zephyr of a thousand clones then costs a thousand model instances, and the vine of trust grows only where the fingerprints differ.
